subject: Next steps: Northshore compliance handshake & evidence sprint
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Cobb <sam.cobb@northshore.com>, Priya Rao <pri.rao@northshore.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Northshore compliance handshake & evidence sprint

Thanks for the time earlier, Sam and Priya — good to meet the security and procurement partners. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned.

Key pain points / goals (as discussed)
- Audit log fidelity & retention: you need request-level audit trails stored for 18 months and support for export to your SIEM.
- SOC 2 coverage & artifacts: need mapping of Redwood controls to your DDQ and SOC 2 report excerpts relevant to data isolation and cryptography.
- DPA and retention terms: procurement needs a DPA draft with standard 18-month retention language plus options for extended retention.
- Pen test evidence & scope: you want pen-test scope, previous summary results (redacted), and a proposed window for a co-ordinated pen test.

Immediate proposed plan (we committed on the call)
1) Evidence sprint kickoff (this Friday, 2028-03-24) — 30m kickoff. Objective: prioritize artifacts required for procurement and compliance. Owner: Irene.
2) Redacted SOC 2 excerpt + control mapping to your DDQ — deliverable by 2028-03-28. Owner: Marissa.
3) Audit log sample & retention demo (showing export to SIEM, retention policy behavior, and searchability) — scheduled POC week of 2028-04-03. Owner: Jordan.
4) DPA initial draft — target 2028-03-30 for procurement review. Owner: Jordan & Irene.
5) Pen test scope worksheet (draft attached) — review with your security team, target final scope by 2028-04-06. Owner: Marissa.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_catalog_template.xlsx (template we will populate during the sprint)
Related links: Drive folder (link below) and our HubSpot record for central tracking.

Ask from your side
- Please confirm the procurement timeline and the preferred attendee(s) for the sprint kickoff.
- Can you share any firm constraints on data residency or retention exceptions beyond the 18 months noted?

If that aligns, Jordan will poll calendars and book the kickoff. Thanks again — we’ll keep the sprint tight and artifact-focused.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
https://www.redwood.ai

-----
Irene Choi
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Cobb <sam.cobb@northshore.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@northshore.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 15:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Northshore compliance handshake & evidence sprint

Irene — thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications from our security team after the call: 

1) Audit logs
- We need logs that include full request metadata (requester identity, request path, model used, token counts, IP) and we need the ability to export in ndjson for ingestion into Splunk. Can your retention demo show the ndjson export and the field-level schema?

2) SOC 2 excerpts
- We primarily need evidence for CC1/CC6 controls around access and logging; redacted report excerpts are fine. Ideally we get a mapping table that ties Redwood control IDs to our DDQ line items.

3) DPA
- Procurement would like to see a DPA that has: (a) audit log retention clause, (b) breach notification SLA (48 hours), and (c) permitted subprocessors list. If you can include a DPA draft, that will speed our internal review.

4) Pen test
- We will need a scope that includes both black-box and credentialed API testing and a proposed remediation SLA. We also require a redacted summary of a prior test (no PII).

Procurement timeline: we are aiming to complete vendor selection by 2028-04-15. Kickoff attendees: me, Priya Rao (Security), and Felipe (Procurement lead) — I copied procurement.

Irene — can you confirm the kickoff time window you have in mind (mornings PST are best for our team)? Also attaching our internal DDQ extract for mapping.

Thanks,
Sam Cobb
Senior InfoSec Manager
Northshore Bank

Attachments: northshore_ddq.pdf

Appreciate the thorough note, Sam. Couple of commits and logistics from Redwood: 

- Kickoff: we’ll propose Friday 2028-03-24 at 09:30 AM PST; if that works I’ll send a calendar invite. We’ll keep it to 30 minutes and focus on artifact priorities and owners.

- Audit log demo & export: we will prepare an ndjson export sample with the field schema you requested (requester id, request path, model, token counts, region, timestamp, request_id). Deliverable at the POC (week of 2028-04-03). Owner: Jordan (me).

- SOC 2 + mapping: Marissa will deliver a control-mapping table and redacted SOC 2 excerpts by 2028-03-28. Owner: Marissa Cole.

- DPA draft: I’m attaching a first-pass DPA_Draft_v1.pdf. This includes an audit-log retention clause (18 months by default + addendum for extended terms), 48h breach notification SLA, and our standard subprocessors list. Please route to Felipe in procurement and let us know redlines.

- Pen test scope: attached pen_test_scope_v0.1.xlsx — includes both black-box and credentialed API testing options and a proposed remediation SLA (30 days for critical findings). We can coordinate an NDA + rules of engagement if needed. Owner: Marissa.

Action table (owners & targets)
- Kickoff (Irene) — schedule by EOD 2028-03-22
- DPA v1 (Jordan) — send to procurement by 2028-03-30
- SOC2 mapping (Marissa) — 2028-03-28
- Audit log export sample & POC (Jordan) — week of 2028-04-03
- Pen test scope final (Marissa & Sam) — 2028-04-06

Tracking: I created a HubSpot engagement under DEAL-4981 and attached the Drive folder for artifact exchange: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-northshore-evidence

If that schedule looks good I’ll confirm invites. Happy to adjust times for Felipe & Priya.

Thanks — Jordan
